reviewer.name: Codex independent Hanshu 036 post-curation chronology auditor

summary: Complete fresh independent post-curation audit of all 292 Chinese units, 23 temporal/hint items, and 9 people. The eight legendary qualitative records and four retrospective references remain source-faithful. The curated Emperor Wu campaign content is preserved, but its claim, event chronology, and hint intentionally retain explicit source-qualified research holds because 至武帝 has no chapter-local regnal-year conversion or personal endpoint. No further defect or omitted dated personal event was found.

findings.problem: The curated extraction intentionally retains unresolved source-qualified chronology for Emperor Wu. 至武帝 gives a reign setting but no local regnal year or personal activity endpoint, so the research holds cannot pass date approval.
findings.action: Obtain independently sourced, hash-pinned chronology if a more specific date is required; otherwise preserve these holds and leave this audit research-blocked.
